set.signal: Capacity projects (half-year report): the 'ultra-pure spherical powder for high-performance high-speed substrates' project (budget RMB 423,239,800.00) was 24.93% complete at end-June 2026, with a planned 36-month construction period and phase 1 built and in production; the 'high-thermal-conductivity high-purity spherical powder' project has a planned 18-month construction period. A new 'high-performance spherical silica for advanced packaging' project (budget RMB 75,000,000.00) was 24.86% complete, and the advanced-packaging high-performance spherical powder project (budget RMB 50,000,000.00) reached 100.00% progress.
